scientific_integrity: Full infinite mathematical arguments are supplied; exhaustive finite checks are corroboration only. No claim of external certification or independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: The word alphabet is fixed, labeled, and of size at least two; universality is relative to the complete alphabet.
Only forbidding immediate equal letters is covered; general transition graphs and nonuniform sources are excluded.
The random-source asymptotics are for each fixed alphabet size and the natural consistent prefix coupling.
An unindexed equivalent explicit enumeration remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Subsequence universality in adjacency-distinct words: exact enumeration and renewal laws
